facts.fact: The Government of South Sudan's National ICT Policy sets a government policy statement for the telecommunications, postal and information technology sectors; the page prints no year, so the published date of 2012 is used and the policy is read as adopted because the government has published it and nothing calls it a draft.

The policy text (policy statement, postal, telecommunications and information technology sector policy) is held on the ICT Policy Africa document page as a government publication, of which page 1 of 3 was captured; the date is the published date of 2012, the page printing none.
